verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile is a developer client for GitHub repositories, so interactive history rewriting is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows deleting, editing, squashing, or reordering commits. The docs cover reviewing, merging, Copilot tasks, and code search, and a community user notes the app 'doesn't really seem to be a git client.'

support.subject: As a power-user, I can interactively rewrite history by deleting, editing, squashing, or reordering commits
